overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Mid-Cap Growth ETF (VOT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund tracks an index of mid-cap stocks in the US. Holdings are selected and weighed based on growth factors. VOT was launched on Aug 17, 2006 and is issued by Vanguard.
